extra.message: The 'username' query parameter from the request is concatenated directly into a Jinja2 template string via Jinja2.from_string("Welcome " + username + "!").render(). Since the untrusted input becomes part of the template source itself (not passed as a render context variable), an attacker can inject Jinja2 template syntax (e.g. {{ 7*7 }} or {{ ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__() }}-style sandbox escapes) to achieve server-side template injection, potentially leading to remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
